nodes.text:
2 cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) detected in India. While HMPV is not new, it's important to:

•Practice good hygiene: Wash hands, cover coughs/sneezes.
•Stay home if sick: Protect yourself and others.
•Vaccinate: Flu shots are recommended.
#HMPV #RespiratoryVirus
